# explorer-verify

> explorer-verify verifies the source of deployed smart contracts on block explorers: Etherscan (API v2), Blockscout, Sourcify and Routescan, with one API for a browser, a backend or a CLI. The APIs are experimental before 1.0. `verify()` works with Sourcify, Etherscan v2, Routescan, Blockscout and standalone Etherscan-compatible explorers. The npm package ships these pages under `docs/` with its own `llms.txt`, so an agent working in `node_modules` reads the docs of the installed version.

## Instructions

Start here. A submit publishes the source on a public explorer and cannot be undone. Dry-run first, show the person the result, and submit only after they say yes. Read these pages first, in order:

- [Quickstart: AI agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/start/quickstart-agent.md): a prompt to paste into an agent, and the safe order: dry run, ask the person, verify
- [Using explorer-verify from an agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/using-from-an-agent.md): which calls and commands are safe and which submit, the dry run, API keys, the stderr handle line, what to do on each exit code, and the Etherscan plan rule
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/skills/explorer-verify/SKILL.md): the skill shipped in the package: build the input, verify, resume from the handle, read the result, and when to stop
- [JSON output and exit codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/json-output.md): the versioned JSON envelope, its JSON Schema, the CLI's nextCommand and the exit code of every outcome, from `explorer-verify/envelope`
- [Errors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/index.md): the fields of every error, its JSON form, the CLI hints, retries, the list of codes, and the `explorer-verify/errors` entry

## User docs

- [User documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/README.md): index of the user pages
- [Which package do I need](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/start/which-package.md): the four packages and the entries of `explorer-verify`, with the task, install command and runtime of each
- [Quickstart: browser dapp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/start/quickstart-browser.md): a Vite page that runs `dryRun()` on the sample request with no key, prints `dry-run sourcify exact`, then calls `verify()`
- [Quickstart: Node.js script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/start/quickstart-node.md): a TypeScript script run by Node.js 22.18 or later that runs `dryRun()` on the sample request with no key, then calls `verify()`
- [Quickstart: SDK wrapper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/start/quickstart-sdk-wrapper.md): a wrapper function on `explorer-verify/core` with the Sourcify client only, which maps `invalid-input` onto its own error class and runs a dry run
- [Quickstart: the CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/start/quickstart-cli.md): download the sample request, dry run it with `npx @explorer-verify/cli`, point the command at a Foundry or Hardhat project, verify
- [Quickstart: a Foundry project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/start/quickstart-foundry.md): dry run the sample request, `forge build --build-info`, then `--foundry .` with `--contract`, dry run and verify
- [Quickstart: a Hardhat project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/start/quickstart-hardhat.md): not a Hardhat plugin; dry run the sample request, build with the deploy profile, then `--hardhat .` with `--contract`, dry run and verify
- [Deploy a contract from a dapp and verify it](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/tutorials/deploy-and-verify-from-a-dapp.md): tutorial: ship the build files with a dapp, deploy from a browser wallet on Sepolia, verify on Sourcify with no key, resume after a reload, read the result, and verify on Etherscan through the server handler
- [Verify a contract shipped in an npm package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-a-contract-from-an-npm-package.md): build the verification input from build-info, artifacts, Standard JSON or Solidity metadata and sources of unknown origin
- [Verify contracts your package ships](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-contracts-your-package-ships.md): for an SDK that deploys its own contracts: ship the Standard JSON input and a manifest, load them with `import()` only when verification runs (an application that never verifies does not load them, and a browser does not fetch them), and call `verify()` with the address and the creation transaction hash, in a browser or on a backend
- [Verify a contract from a Hardhat project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-a-hardhat-project.md): `@explorer-verify/hardhat` finds a contract's artifact and build-info in a Hardhat 2 or Hardhat 3 project and builds the input
- [Verify from deployed bytecode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-deployed-bytecode.md): `buildVerifyInputFromBytecode` from `explorer-verify/resolve` reads the metadata hash in the bytecode, finds the metadata and sources on Sourcify or your IPFS gateway, checks every hash and builds the input
- [Verify a proxy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-a-proxy.md): verify the implementation, verify the proxy, then link them with `linkProxy()`: what Etherscan, Blockscout and Sourcify each do, the `linked` and `not-linked` results, and a link still pending
- [Verify a contract from a Foundry project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-a-foundry-project.md): `@explorer-verify/foundry` finds a contract's artifact, build-info or sources under `out/` and builds the input
- [verify()](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/verify.md): `verify()` and `dryRun()`, their options, results, errors and exit codes, what `verify()` does step by step, linked libraries and constructor arguments
- [checkStatus()](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/check-status.md): resume a submitted verification from its handle, the handle's one-line form, `formatHandle`, `parseHandle`, `tryParseHandle` and `isHandleString`, also from `explorer-verify/handle`, an entry that never reaches the verification code
- [Verify on several explorers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/advanced/verify-on-several-explorers.md): `verifyEach()`, which verifies on several backends in one call with one outcome per backend, its `backends` entries, keys and exit code
- [Abort and resume](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/advanced/abort-and-resume.md): stop `verify()` with a signal, keep the handle from the `verify.submitted` event, and resume with `checkStatus()`
- [API keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/api-keys.md): `apiKeys` and `route.apiKey`, which host gets each key, where in the request it goes, the environment variables the CLI will read, and the Etherscan plan rule
- [Routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/routing.md): how a chain resolves to a backend, the routing table and its checks, `route`, `allowSourcifyFallback`, and which host gets a key
- [Core entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/core.md): `explorer-verify/core`, which takes the explorer clients from `explorer-verify/clients/<name>` and the routing table from `explorer-verify/table` instead of loading them, so a one-file bundle holds only the clients it uses: its options, every client and the errors for what a call leaves out
- [Run the server handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/run-the-server-handler.md): `createVerifyHandler` in a Next.js App Router route and a Cloudflare Worker: the key from the platform's secret store, the guards, CORS and origin settings, the browser's `handlerUrl`, and Etherscan's terms
- [Verify from a browser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-a-browser.md): a dry run on the sample request, then `verify()` with the library loaded on first use, the handle kept across a reload, a CDN import map, keyless explorers called directly, and Etherscan through the server handler
- [Verify from Node.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-node.md): a dry run on the sample request, then `verify()` with keys from the environment in `apiKeys`; a service with a logger, events to telemetry, a long budget and a queue; `verifyEach()` on Etherscan and Sourcify at once; and Deno and Bun
- [Verify from an edge function](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-an-edge-function.md): a dry run on the sample request, then a Cloudflare Worker that submits in one request and resumes with `checkStatus()` in later ones, with the key from the Worker's secrets and a bearer token
- [Bundle size](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/advanced/bundle-size.md): what `verify()` adds to a page: one chunk per explorer client loaded on first use, the routing table chunk, the small entries for handles and errors, and the measured sizes
- [Resume from a job queue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/advanced/resume-from-a-job-queue.md): a backend job that polls a queued handle with `checkStatus()`, never submits, returns `again` while the explorer checks, and when to stop retrying
- [Verify from CI with the CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-ci-with-the-cli.md): verify from a Foundry or Hardhat build with `--foundry` or `--hardhat`, dry run, `--json` and `jq`, exit codes in a shell `case`, and keys from CI secrets
- [Wrap explorer-verify behind your tool's API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/wrap-explorer-verify-in-your-tool.md): for a tool that already verifies contracts: call `verify()` and `checkStatus()` inside its existing functions, map its settings onto `VerifyOptions`, the behaviour that changes, a table that maps every error code, how to ship only the clients it uses with `explorer-verify/core`, which small entry to re-export each name from, and tests that replay recorded answers through an injected `fetch`
- [Server handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/server-handler.md): `createVerifyHandler` from `explorer-verify/server`, which keeps the Etherscan key on your server and forwards only submit, status, a reduced lookup and, when turned on, the two proxy-link actions: its options, guards, who may verify, refusal codes and the Etherscan terms
- [Error `invalid-input`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/invalid-input.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `not-confirmed`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/not-confirmed.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `unsupported-chain`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/unsupported-chain.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `network`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/network.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `rate-limited`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/rate-limited.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `timeout`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/timeout.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `unexpected-response`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/unexpected-response.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `in-progress`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/in-progress.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `unknown-state`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/unknown-state.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `job-not-found`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/job-not-found.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `cancelled`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/cancelled.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `incomplete-input`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/incomplete-input.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code

- [Error `internal-error`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/internal-error.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code

- [Error `metadata-unavailable`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/metadata-unavailable.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code

- [Error `proxy-link-pending`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/proxy-link-pending.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `proxy-link-unknown-state`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/proxy-link-unknown-state.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `handler-refused`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/handler-refused.md): cause, fix, hint, CLI hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/cli.md): the `explorer-verify` command: `verify` from a Foundry or Hardhat project or from build files, `status`, `--dry-run` and `--input-json`, and from its help: examples, options, environment variables, exit codes, `--help` and `--version` with `--json`, stdout and stderr, log levels and colour
- [Sourcify](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/sourcify.md): what is sent to Sourcify, how each answer becomes a result or an error, and its side effects
- [Etherscan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/etherscan.md): what is sent to Etherscan v2, how each `result` text becomes a result or an error, and Similar Match
- [Routescan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/routescan.md): what is sent to Routescan, its per-chain URL, the optional key in a header, and the answers it adds to Etherscan's
- [Blockscout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/blockscout.md): what is sent to a Blockscout instance, how each answer becomes a result or an error, partial matches, the empty-answer retry and rate limits
- [Etherscan-compatible explorers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/etherscan-compatible.md): what is sent to a standalone explorer that serves Etherscan's API on its own host, the key in `route.apiKey`, no `chainid`, and the retired Etherscan host answer
- [Match types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/explanation/match-types.md): what `exact` and `partial` mean per explorer, the metadata hash, builds that can only reach `partial`, automatic matching and why `verify()` looks up first
- [Etherscan plans and attribution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/explanation/etherscan-plans-and-attribution.md): which Etherscan plan a use needs, the "Powered by Etherscan.io APIs" rule, keys off the client and the server handler's position
- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/explanation/glossary.md): one-line definitions of backend, route, `routedBy`, routing table, handle, envelope, lookup, match grade, dry run and server handler
- [Logging and events](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/logging-and-events.md): the logger, the typed stage events, the event JSON Schema, and what happens when a callback throws
- [API reference](https://aelmanaa.github.io/explorer-verify/api/index.md): every export of each package, generated from TSDoc, for the version on npm `latest`; the `.d.ts` files of an installed package carry the same comments
